To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the receptor for angio-tensin II has been cloned, sequenced and expressed in mammalian cells.
we have expressed in COS-7 cells a cDNA encoding a bovine type-1 angiotensin receptor.
we cloned and expressed the complementary DNA for a receptor that mediates the actions of the peptide hormone angiotensin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cloning and expression of a bovine adrenal complementary DNA encoding a type-1 angiotensin receptor.
the expression cloning of the type-1 angiotensin receptor, and we have demonstrated its expression in bovine adrenal gland and kidney.
the molecular biology of the angiotensin receptor, which is a member of a superfamily of G protein-cou-pled receptors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the cloned receptor is the type 1 receptor for angio-tensin II, which is expressed in the adrenal medulla, kidney and adrenal cortex, and is responsible for the actions of angiotensin on Ca2+ and electrolyte trans-port.
the cDNA encoding the bovine adrenal angio-tensin II type-I receptor has been cloned and its function characterized in vitro.
the receptor cloned here encodes a protein with the characteristics of the type-1 angiotensin receptor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bovine type-1 angiotensin receptor is the product of a gene of 1, 400 base pairs, and the protein encoded by the gene has a molecular mass of 41, 000 daltons.
we cloned a complementary DNA for the bovine angioten-sin II type- 1 receptor and that the receptor is expressed in adrenal medulla, adrenal cortex and kidney.

the receptor cDNA encod-ing the angiotensin type-1 receptor was expressed in COS-7 cells, and that the transfected cells expressed specific and high affinity binding sites for angio-tensin II, a non-peptide antagonist and an antagonist for type- 1 receptor.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the angiotensin type-1 receptor is a member of a family of G protein-cou-pled receptors, and that it is a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of hypertension, cardiac failure, renal failure and other disorders.
the receptor for angio-tensin II is a G protein-cou-pled receptor.
the bovine angiotension receptor can be cloned, which opens the way to cloning of the human angiotension receptor.
